Messages.Author: d
Messages.Body:
Can Eurayle untap one of your own minions as a non-D action, freak
drive, and untap a different Methusaleh's minion as a D-action?

Or does the No-Repeat-Action rule treat both as the same 'type' of
action?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


6.1.6. specifies that an action granted by minion's own card text is
restricted.
